title: Chicken Chili
description: Chicken Chili is a vibrant Indo-Chinese stir-fry featuring tender, marinated chicken tossed with crisp bell peppers, onions, aromatic ginger and garlic, and dried red chilies in a glossy, balanced sauce. High-heat wok cooking gives the dish a smoky, savory character with layers of spicy, sweet, tangy, and umami flavors.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Boneless chicken breast or thigh – 500 g (1 lb), cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.title: For the Sauce
items: Rice vinegar – 1 tbsp (or Chinese black vinegar)
Chili paste – 1 tbsp (Doubanjiang or Sichuan chili bean paste)

ingredients.title: For the Stir-Fry
items: Peanut oil – 2 tbsp (or neutral oil with a high smoke point)
Dried red chilies – 6–8, cut into halves
Onion – 1 medium, diced into large cubes
Green bell pepper – 1, diced into large cubes
Red bell pepper – 1, diced into large cubes

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinating the Chicken
steps: In a bowl, combine chicken with light soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, white pepper, cornstarch, and sesame oil.
Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated.
Set aside to marinate for at least 20 minutes to tenderize and flavor the chicken.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Sauce
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili paste, tomato ketchup, sugar, and chicken stock.
Taste and adjust the sweetness and heat according to preference.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Cooking the Chicken
steps: Heat 1 tbsp peanut oil in a wok over high heat until smoking.
Add the marinated chicken and stir-fry for about 4–5 minutes until lightly golden and almost cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Building the Aromatics
steps: Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the same wok.
Add chopped garlic, ginger, and dried red chilies.
Stir-fry for 10–15 seconds until fragrant, taking care not to burn the aromatics.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Stir-Frying the Vegetables
steps: Add the diced onion and bell peppers to the wok.
Toss quickly over high heat for 1–2 minutes, keeping the vegetables vibrant and slightly crisp.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Combining Everything
steps: Return the cooked chicken to the wok.
Pour in the prepared sauce and toss continuously until the chicken and vegetables are evenly coated in a glossy sauce.
Add the scallions and stir-fry briefly to combine.

instruction.title: Step 7 – Finishing & Serving
steps: Remove the wok from the heat and transfer the chicken chili to a shallow serving bowl or wide-rim plate.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and fresh cilantro leaves.
Serve immediately with steamed jasmine rice or Hakka-style fried rice.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately with steamed jasmine rice.
Pair with Hakka-style fried rice for a heartier Indo-Chinese meal.
Present in a wide-rim white plate or shallow bowl for an elegant restaurant-style appearance.

chefTips: Use high heat throughout the stir-frying process to develop wok hei, the characteristic smoky aroma of wok cooking.
Balance the sauce carefully between spicy, savory, sweet, and tangy flavors.
Do not overcrowd the wok when cooking the chicken, as this can cause it to steam instead of sear.
Keep the vegetables slightly crisp and vibrant to create a contrast with the tender chicken.
For the best texture, the chicken should be tender inside with a lightly crisp, seared exterior.
For an elegant presentation, use a shallow bowl or wide-rim white plate and place the garnish precisely.
